anchor_on.meaning: Latest recorded contact calendar date, or creation calendar date when never contacted. Stored date columns retain their day. Timestamp sources are converted to America/Chicago before taking the date. Never a timestamp.

due_on.meaning: Recorded lead next_action_date when present, otherwise anchor_on plus the subject cadence in calendar days. Never a timestamp.

proposals.days_overdue: Integer difference between the current America/Chicago calendar date and due_on. Only due rows are returned, ordered by due_on, subject_type, subject_id.

owner_filter: Omit owner_slug for all owners, null for unassigned owner_id, or an exact recorded actor slug. Filtering precedes the 1000-row overflow check.
effects: Read only. sent and tasks_created are always false.
